# synology_group (Resource)

A local DSM group. Import by group name. Built-in groups can be imported but never deleted.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Local group name and import identifier.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Reject deletion using the last applied value. Disable in a separate apply before intentionally deleting a custom group.
- `description` (String) Group description. An empty value clears it.

### Read-Only

- `gid` (Number) Numeric DSM group identifier.
